peak_rss.units: bytes on macOS/BSD, kilobytes on Linux (ru_maxrss)
peak_rss.semantics: child_python_process = RUSAGE_SELF of the evaluation process at record time (the evaluation's own peak); production_state = the same measure taken by production at the end of run_operational_planning; solver_subprocesses = RUSAGE_CHILDREN max over the IPOPT executables this evaluation launched; when a post-certification step ran, child_python_process includes it (the ADMM run alone is production_state)

footprint_peak_reported_not_gated.measure: ri_lifetime_max_phys_footprint of the evaluation child (the harness's --child Python process; its IPOPT subprocesses are NOT included -- the same scope as child_python_process_ru_maxrss), read by this launcher with proc_pid_rusage(pid, RUSAGE_INFO_V4) (struct rusage_info_v4, macOS SDK sys/resource.h): the kernel-tracked high-water mark of phys_footprint over the process lifetime -- the footprint analogue of ru_maxrss, so no sampling gap. FINAL value = the read on the EXITED, NOT-YET-REAPED child (ri_proc_exit_abstime != 0), taken on the kqueue EVFILT_PROC NOTE_EXIT event (xnu keeps the exit rusage until the harness reaps with os.wait4, which it polls every POLL_S = 5 s); identity: pid from the harness's launch.json, parent pid == this launcher, command line holds --child and the entry's eval key, ri_proc_start_abstime constant across reads (no pid reuse)

solve_profile.identity: observed == base + sum over network-failure events of [recovery_attempted] + [tier2_attempted]; unsupported when an ESSO recovery event or an 'indeterminate' network event exists
solve_profile.derivation: (1 + n_dso) * n_years * n_days + n_esso_nodes, per cycle, from the planning object
solve_profile.rounds_note: one initialization round + cycles_run ADMM cycles

recovered_only_identity.note: pre-W35 rule, REPORTED not gated: credits retries only to RECOVERED blocks, so an unrecovered block's attempts go uncounted (78a9b230)

memory_preflight_at_run.vm_stat_header: Mach Virtual Memory Statistics: (page size of 16384 bytes)
memory_preflight_at_run.rule: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied) x page size >= 1 x 3.5 GiB
memory_preflight_at_run.rule_rationale: non-reclaimable load = wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied pages; file-backed pages (active or inactive) are cache the kernel reclaims on demand, so free + inactive under-counts what new processes can obtain (free + inactive recorded alongside)

budget_derivation.budget: 3.5 GiB per child = the measured persist peak (3.23 GiB) + 0.27 GiB margin
